summary: Verified SEO package + FAQ feature end-to-end. All 9 requested test scenarios pass. Note: required frontend restart (sudo supervisorctl restart frontend) to pick up new /public/index.html — CRA/craco HtmlWebpackPlugin had cached the previous head. After restart the preview URL serves the correct SEO head, FAQ CMS round-trip works (6 -> 7 items, edit visible publicly), per-page titles swap correctly on SPA navigation, admin pages set noindex,nofollow via Topbar's useSEO, Save Details partial update works without regression, and /admin + /admin/students load after login.
action_items: No code changes needed. Operational note for main agent: whenever /public/index.html is edited, the frontend dev server must be restarted (sudo supervisorctl restart frontend) so that the preview URL serves the updated <head>. Vercel production build does not have this issue (static index.html).
critical_code_review_comments: Faq.jsx: items use shape {q, a} (matches backend DEFAULT_CONTENT.faq.items). ContentPage FAQ tab also uses q/a — consistent.

ContentPage Save Details only persists the 'contact' section, not 'hero.stats' which are also edited in the Details tab. Clicking Save Details after editing a hero stat value will silently drop those edits. Not a regression (behaviour unchanged), but worth considering a combined save or a visible warning.
sitemap.xml only lists / and /apply; if there are indexable deep links (e.g. /admin is intentionally excluded) consider adding lastmod to improve crawl signals.
seed_data_creation: Added a TEST question to FAQ via CMS and removed it in cleanup; restored original answer 0 text.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SEO head items (title, description, canonical, og:*, twitter:card, CollegeOrUniversity JSON-LD) are confirmed in served HTML after a frontend restart. FAQ section renders 6 default items from /api/content faq.items (shape {q,a}), first item open by default, accordion toggles correctly, faq-schema <script id='faq-schema'> FAQPage JSON-LD exists with 6 Questions. Per-page titles swap on SPA nav. Admin useSEO sets noindex,nofollow on all /admin* pages. CMS FAQ round-trip (edit answer + add question + save) persists and reflects on public landing page immediately. Save Details without changes still returns 200 and shows 'Saved — the website is updated.'
rca of the issue: Initial curl of preview URL showed stale <title>S V INSTITUTIONS</title> and old description. Root cause: CRA/craco webpack-dev-server caches /public/index.html via HtmlWebpackPlugin at startup; subsequent edits to /public/index.html don't hot-reload the HTML shell. Mitigation: restart frontend (sudo supervisorctl restart frontend). Verified served HTML afterwards exactly matches /app/frontend/public/index.html.
